offers.name: Read permissions
offers.description: Other products list this product's permissions, for the roles of the website's staff.

offers.name: Export a person's data
offers.description: Other products ask this product for everything it keeps about one person.

offers.name: Erase a person's data
offers.description: Other products ask this product to erase or anonymize one person's data.

features.name: Visitor chat
features.description: The ready chat widget and the visitor API for your own chat screens, with window.SSChat.

features.name: AI replies
features.description: The AI answers visitors with your own AI provider key (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini or any OpenAI-compatible service).

features.name: Knowledge base
features.description: FAQ entries and articles the AI answers from.

features.name: Custom webhook tools
features.description: Tools the AI can call on your own server, signed with your tool signing secret.

features.name: Book-a-slot tool
features.description: The AI offers free time slots and books one through your own booking endpoint.

features.name: Shop assistant
features.description: The AI answers from your store's catalog, deals, customer orders and package tracking, with product cards in the widget.

features.name: Lead capture and flows
features.description: Collects contact details as leads, and runs short scripted flows started by a page or a keyword.

features.name: Inbox
features.description: The inbox widget where your staff read and answer conversations.

features.name: Human handoff
features.description: Hands a conversation to a person: the AI stops and your staff take over, with office hours.

features.name: Moderation
features.description: Hides personal data, filters leaks from AI answers, applies a link policy and your blocked terms.

features.name: Reports
features.description: The reports widget: conversations, AI and staff answers, reply times, ratings, leads and AI tokens.

features.name: Import
features.description: Staff, guests and conversations with their messages moved in from another system with ss-import (server token only; no messages, events or alerts). Our admins switch it on for a migration and off after it.

permissions.name: See conversations, leads and AI summaries; set your own presence
Reply, attach, send transcripts, ask for ratings; pause the AI if allowed
Status, assignment, notes, saved replies, fields, max chats, AI pause, deletes
